name: vfx-text-cursor
title: Text Cursor Rays
description: A wordmark rises into frame and a cursor sweeps across it, throwing prismatic light rays through the letters (a 112-sample ray accumulation shader); the mark shrinks away into a frosted glass card where a word is typed, slides into place, and the headline changes to a closing line.
useWhen: A logo sting where light rays sweep through the wordmark, followed by a typed announcement card.
A product announcement: wordmark, then a word typed into a glass card and a closing line.
avoidWhen: The logo must stay still and crisp: the rays smear the wordmark while the cursor passes.
The render budget is tight: the shader takes 112 samples per pixel on a CPU renderer.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: Wordmark
variables.description: The wordmark the light rays pass through (a placeholder name).

variables.label: Typed word
variables.description: Typed out in the card, large, before it slides to its place.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the light-ray shader is drawn at, then scaled up. It samples 112 times per pixel, so keep it low on CPU renderers.
